name: Yanai (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Yanai city emblem in white: a ring open at the fly crossed by stylised wave strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Yanai, a city in Yamaguchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 October 2005.

features.role: Yanai city emblem — a ring open at the fly crossed by stylised wave strokes
